title: Drive platform adoption and migrations
summary: Internal platforms only create value when teams adopt them. Make moving easy, show the benefit and support teams through it.

beginner: List the teams who should adopt and what they use now.
Show the benefit in their terms: time saved, fewer incidents, lower cost.
Make the first step easy with guides, templates and help.
Start with a few willing teams and share their results.
Track adoption and help teams who are stuck.
experienced: Agree deprecation dates for old systems with leaders.
Measure platform value, not just adoption.
Build a community of practice around the platform.

toolExamples.github: Provide template repositories that start teams on the platform.
toolExamples.confluence: Publish migration guides and an adoption tracker.

pitfalls: Running old and new systems forever
